# List of international trips made by foreign secretaries of the United Kingdom

The following is a list of international trips made by foreign secretaries of the United Kingdom in chronological order.
James Cleverly (2022-2023)
Cleverly visited 19 countries and territories during his tenure as Foreign Secretary.
David Cameron (2023-2024)
Cameron visited 34 countries and territories during his tenure as Foreign Secretary. He being the first Minister to visit the Falkland Islands since 2016 and the first to ever visit Paraguay, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan and Tajikistan.
David Lammy (2024-present)
Lammy has visited 41 countries and territories during his tenure as Foreign Secretary. He being the first UK Foreign Secretary to visit Ireland since 2017 and to visit Pakistan since 2021.
